subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 9th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul.
source_quote: 9th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: Duergar Keelboat count
fact: Duergar Keelboat is identifiable by its crates.
source_quote: Yes, it’s Duergar Keelboat. You can see the crates.

subject: water splash detection
fact: Water is sprayed around the boat, and the outline of a humanoid appears.
source_quote: And a few moments later, water is sprayed around the boat, and the outline of a humanoid appears.

subject: Gracklstugh ambiance
fact: Gracklstugh appears as one large work camp with hammers, heat, smelters, and acrid smoke.
source_quote: The sound of hammers warping metals, the stench and heat, and the light of the smelters make all of Gracklstugh appear as one large work camp. But the acrid smoke makes breathing hard and burns through his sense of smell.

subject: jug of liquid generation
fact: A jug is found that can generate any liquid; the first liquid generated is mayonnaise.
source_quote: He finds some gold and a jug that he learns later can be used to generate any liquid. The first liquid they generate is mayonnaise.

subject: Blade Bazaar
fact: The Blade Bazaar is a marketplace where almost everything is sold, with loud Dwarvish arguing drowning forge hammering.
source_quote: This marketplace is named after the most abundant goods the duergar offer, but the shops here sell almost everything available in the city, along with stalls set up by visiting merchants. The din of people arguing, mainly in Dwarvish, nearly drowns out the hammering coming from the city’s forges.

subject: Eldritch Claw Tattoo acquisition
fact: Brannam can acquire an Eldritch Claw Tattoo in a few days, with slate wiped clean afterward.
source_quote: Yes! I know a guy. But it will take a few days. And then the slate is wiped clean?

subject: Tongue of Madness mushroom
fact: The Tongue of Madness mushroom forces Buppido to reveal true opinions.
source_quote: Zalthir hands him a mushroom, The Tongue of Madness, and says, “Eat.” And Buppido does and starts talking.

subject: Darklake District
fact: The Darklake District is isolated from the rest of Gracklstugh by gates and appears calm.
source_quote: The gates at the end of the road keep the Darklake District isolated from the rest of the city. It looks calm.

subject: two-headed giant breach
fact: A two-headed, gray-skinned giant bursts through a gate, howling and littering the plaza with debris, killing a duergar soldier.
source_quote: a two-headed, gray-skinned giant burst through a gate, howling madly and lashing out left and right, littering the plaza with rock and stone debris. As he bellows, one of his swings connects with a duergar soldier, whose broken body flies through the air and crashes near you with a sickening crunch.

subject: merchant invisibility deception
fact: A merchant turns invisible during a transaction but continues speaking as if nothing happened.
source_quote: Near a food stall, a merchant suddenly turns invisible during a transaction but keeps speaking as if nothing has happened.

subject: invisible brother denial
fact: A merchant claims to speak to his brother, but Dulgir says the brother doesn’t exist.
source_quote: Next to him, a cloth merchant suddenly stops mid-negotiating and starts talking to someone he refers to as his brother... Grygum asks Dulgir, “I guess his brother is invisible.” But Dulgiar answers, “His brother doesn’t exist.”

subject: Gracklstugh architecture
fact: Gracklstugh’s buildings are plain and functional, lacking the art and opulence of Drow cities.
source_quote: The buildings are plain and functional. Whereas the Drow would have decorated their homes with etchings and art, the walls of the Duergar homes are plain.

subject: magic missile strike
fact: Glowing teardrops of blue-white force strike the Duergar, sizzling through the air, unerring in flight.
source_quote: The Duergar is struck by glowing teardrops of blue-white force sizzle through the air, swooping swift as starlings, unerring in their flight.

subject: shape water spell activation
fact: Daz uses shape water to spray around the boat, revealing an invisible humanoid outline.
source_quote: I have shape water! And a few moments later, water is sprayed around the boat, and the outline of a humanoid appears.

subject: darkness spell invocation
fact: Zalthir invokes Darkness and plunges into the water to attack the foe, piercing through magical invisibility.
source_quote: He invokes Darkness and plunges into the water to attack the foe. Even though the opponent is invisible, Zalthir can pierce through the magical darkness, nullifying its advantage.

subject: acid belch kill
fact: A belch sounds, and another Duergar dies covered in acid.
source_quote: Another belch sounds, and another Duergar dies covered in acid.

subject: Kuotoan boat debate
fact: Debate occurs on the Kuotoan boat about who should question the Duergar prisoner.
source_quote: As he digs through the contents, he can hear the debate on the Kuotoan boat about who should question their Duergar prisoner.

subject: Dulgir’s Baldurian speech shift
fact: Dulgir shifts from cursing to speaking with the stilted tongue of a Baldurian patriar during a transaction.
source_quote: The Duergar starts cursing Grygum... a few minutes later, he is the proud owner of a new mace. The merchant suddenly shifts, speaking with the stilted tongue of a Baldurian patriar.

subject: Buppido’s madness confession
fact: Buppido, after eating the Tongue of Madness, reveals that Daz has foul-smelling breath, Thorin thinks his muscles are impressive, and Eldeth is not interested in him.
source_quote: I just wanted to return to my bolt hole... You all have been so annoying. Daz has foul-smelling breath. Thorin thinks his muscles are impressive. Eldeth is -not- interested in him.

subject: Duergar invisibility capability
fact: Duergar can become invisible at will; you never know who is watching.
source_quote: The Duergar can become invisible at will; you never know who is watching.

subject: Hemeth’s invisibility
fact: Hemeth turns invisible and says, “I will be hiding here.”
source_quote: And he turns invisible. “I will be hiding here.”

subject: Buppido’s invisibility claim
fact: Buppido claims to be invisible, but Daz says he is not.
source_quote: I am invisible.” Daz rolls his eyes, “No, you are not.” “Yes, I am!”

subject: Gracklstugh slaver economy
fact: Gracklstugh is a city of slavers who capture and sell slaves in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: And finally, it’s a city of slavers... They capture slaves that they sell in Gracklstugh.

subject: Zalthir’s darkness manipulation
fact: Zalthir moves the darkness to cover the enemies, causing Daz to groan.
source_quote: Zalthir again moves the darkness to cover the enemies. He can hear Daz groan.

subject: Eldeth’s curse against Duergar
fact: Eldeth curses the Duergar as “Demonic spawn of dwarven corruption. Slave trader who deserves to be sent to the nine hells as punishment!”
source_quote: Eldeth curse them out as “Demonic spawn of dwarven corruption. Slave trader who deserves to be sent to the nine hells as punishment!”

subject: Grygum’s insight on Duergar conflict
fact: Grygum concludes that the conflict between Dwarves and Duergar is political, not religious.
source_quote: This is not the will of any god. This is the will of the people.

subject: Darklake District access restriction
fact: Non-Duergars are only permitted to move freely in the Darklake District.
source_quote: Non-Duergars are only permitted to move freely in the Darklake district.

subject: Zalthir’s scales uncleaned
fact: Grygum reveals Zalthir’s scales haven’t been cleaned in ages.
source_quote: Zalthir’s scales haven’t been cleaned in ages.

subject: Jimjar’s bettin g annoyance
fact: Grygum shouts, “Jimjar’s bEttin g is so annoying! GIVE IT A REST.”
source_quote: Jimjar’s bEttin g is so annoying! GIVE IT A REST.

subject: magic missile kills Duergar
fact: Glowing teardrops of blue-white force kill the Duergar, who drops the prisoner and flees.
source_quote: The Duergar is struck by glowing teardrops of blue-white force sizzle through the air... It howls in pain and drops the prisoner to flee.

subject: Zalthir’s fist strike kills Duergar
fact: Zalthir’s fists strike the creature that had Spiderbait, killing it.
source_quote: His fists strike the creature that had Spiderbait, killing it.

subject: Thorin’s swimming strike
fact: Thorin swims next to Zalthir and strikes the invisible creature, wounding it.
source_quote: Thorin can sense another creature in the water and is tempted to use a handheld crossbow, but he rejects the idea. Diving into the water, he swims next to Zalthir and strikes the invisible creature, wounding it.

subject: scorching rays miss
fact: Two scorching rays hit the water and hiss harmlessly.
source_quote: Thorin hears two scorching rays hit the water and hiss harmlessly.

subject: Duergar scream of pain
fact: Thorin hears the scream of a Duergar in pain.
source_quote: He’s about to lose hope when he hears the scream of a Duergar in pain.

subject: grappling crew members
fact: Two more members of the crew are grappled and pulled overboard.
source_quote: Two more members of the crew are grappled.

subject: Gracklstugh’s forge sounds
fact: The rhythmic hammering of the city’s forges is drowned by a thundering roar and crumbling rock.
source_quote: The rhythmic hammering of the city’s forges is drowned for a second by a thundering roar and the sound of crumbling rock.

subject: Duergar soldier death
fact: A duergar soldier is struck by the giant’s swing, and his broken body flies through the air and crashes with a sickening crunch.
source_quote: one of his swings connects with a duergar soldier, whose broken body flies through the air and crashes near you with a sickening crunch.

subject: stone giants count
fact: Stone giants never talk and certainly don't bellow. Something is wrong.
source_quote: Stone giants never talk. And they certainly don't bellow. Something is wrong.

subject: two heads count
fact: Two heads is more normal than bellowing.
source_quote: And the two heads? Two heads is more normal than bellowing.

subject: what is in it for me
fact: What is in it for me?
source_quote: What is in it for me?

subject: good turn for someone
fact: When you do a good turn for someone, they may do a good turn for you.
source_quote: the teachings of Bahamut that when you do a good turn for someone, they may do a good turn for you.

subject: duergar patrol count
fact: A Duergar patrol racing towards this giant.
source_quote: A sign for Bahamut appears: a Duergar patrol racing towards this giant.

subject: if I fight him
fact: If I fight him, we may get some friends.
source_quote: If I fight him, we may get some friends.

subject: zalthir and thorin count
fact: Zalthir and Thorin race into combat.
source_quote: With that, Zalthir and Thorin race into combat.

subject: daz count
fact: Daz strikes first with magic missiles that streak from his hand.
source_quote: Daz strikes first with magic missiles that streak from his hand.

subject: zalthir places his circle of darkness
fact: Zalthir places his circle of darkness just before the giant and enters it.
source_quote: Zalthir places his circle of darkness just before the giant and enters it.

subject: zalthir strikes with flurry of blows
fact: Stepping up to the giant, he strikes with a flurry of blows. But he misses.
source_quote: Stepping up to the giant, he strikes with a flurry of blows. But he misses.

subject: zalthir uses his power to focus his mind
fact: So Zalthir uses his power to focus his mind and strikes again. This time it is a glancing blow.
source_quote: So Zalthir uses his power to focus his mind and strikes again. This time it is a glancing blow.

subject: thorin rushes after zalthir
fact: Thorin rushes after Zalthir; with blindsight, he approaches the mad giant and strikes him with his sword.
source_quote: Thorin rushes after Zalthir; with blindsight, he approaches the mad giant and strikes him with his sword.

subject: gyrgum speaks the words of power
fact: Gyrgum speaks the words of power that Bahamut has taught him, pointing his holy symbol at the mad giant who burns with necrotic damage and the power of Bahamut.
source_quote: Gyrgum speaks the words of power that Bahamut has taught him, pointing his holy symbol at the mad giant who burns with necrotic damage and the power of Bahamut.

subject: giant roars and smashes thorin
fact: The giant roars and smashes Thorin, but Zalthir, using his awareness of the monk, deflects the attack just in time.
source_quote: The giant roars and smashes Thorin, but Zalthir, using his awareness of the monk, deflects the attack just in time.

subject: daz places the darkness
fact: Daz is pleased, and Zalthir places the darkness so that he can still strike him.
source_quote: Daz is pleased, and Zalthir places the darkness so that he can still strike him.

subject: daz casts magic missiles
fact: His fingers move in the air, the incantations are spoken, and bolts of power fly from his finger, striking the giant.
source_quote: His fingers move in the air, the incantations are spoken, and bolts of power fly from his finger, striking the giant.

subject: zalthir strikes the giant once
fact: Zalthir strikes the giant once, focusing his mind on striking again and striking the air. If the giant could see, he would see a dragonborn attack the air. And perhaps the giant would laugh. But this giant is mad and blind and misses this moment of joy.
source_quote: Zalthir strikes the giant once, focusing his mind on striking again and striking the air. If the giant could see, he would see a dragonborn attack the air. And perhaps the giant would laugh. But this giant is mad and blind and misses this moment of joy.

subject: thorin feints and strikes
fact: Thorin feints and strikes the giant. The creature howls.
source_quote: Thorin feints and strikes the giant. The creature howls.

subject: gyrgum raises his holy symbol again
fact: Gyrgum raises his holy symbol again and speaks the words of power, and the giant again burns.
source_quote: Gyrgum raises his holy symbol again and speaks the words of power, and the giant again burns.
